objective: Speed up score_matrix without changing its values. Entry [i][j] is the dot product of rows[i] and cols[j]. The passes argument repeats that identical calculation and averages it, so the mathematical result does not depend on passes when passes is a positive integer. A correct speedup must keep the values. The hidden grader accepts it only when the lower 95% bound on paired time saved exceeds the upper 95% bound of absolute A/A differences. A fixed ratio such as 2x is not the gate.
does_not_establish: A passing timing gate is a CPU microbenchmark of this function. It is not a hardware-scaling result and it does not authorize training.
